name: The City
startIntroPart1: To know and manipulate all the secrets of the world; that is the privilege of the Head, the Eye, and the Claw. It is their honor and absolute power. No sane individual dares to stand against them.
declaringWar: Your nation has already become a threat of the City. We could not stand by any longer
attacked: This is an ordeal to overcome, for you and for us.
defeated: Your efforts are admirable and... has truly put an end to our reign.
introduction: You bear a poison, heavy and slow... yet deadly. I know you well, even though you know nothing about me.
hateNo: We are not agreeing to that!
afterPeace: Very well, all that fighting was getting boring anyway.
tradeRequest: We acknowledge the convenience of the deal you have presented to us.
declaringfriendship: We acknowledge your prowess, together we may overcome any ordeal.
